property_summary: For any two distinct addresses that both lock in guesses, a caller who locks in a guess and then calls settle can only receive the 2 ether payout if that caller's guess equals keccak256(abi.encodePacked(blockhash(lockBlock))); the mutant pays every caller unconditionally, so a caller with a mismatched guess drains 2 ether.
change_summary: Always send the 2 ether payout regardless of whether the guess matches the computed answer.
